contentPattern: Row with the video source as a link or URL text (MP4/WebM, YouTube or Vimeo), optional row with a placeholder/poster picture. Without a placeholder the video autoplays muted and looped when in view (controls instead under reduced motion); with a placeholder a play button loads the video with controls.
usage: Promotional product / campaign video in a rounded frame (silent looping app demos), or a poster image with play button inside a dark purple frame.
reuseGuidance: Use for self-hosted promo or demo videos. Use 'image-dark-purple' for a poster image with play button inside a thick colored frame. For YouTube player embeds with title bar use embed-video.
